title: Listen With Headphones: An Email From A Slutty Co-Worker (Video (Standard))

Make sure you don't squirm too much. I don't think anyone else will be watching you as closely as I am- only I know what you are going to be listening to after all - but still. This is a professional workplace environment. And I don't want anyone else knowing what a slut I am for you.
author: Mistress Shibby
